senses.gloss: a catch, a bag-like receptacle for catch in the fisher’s net; the solid web of the net-work.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 23:5">Kel. XXIII, 5</cite> <he>החרם טמא מפני זוּטוֹ</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="E00293"><he>הזוטו</he></cite>, R. Hai G. <he>הזוּטָן</he>, Var. <he>הזומן</he>) the net is fit for levitical uncleanness on account of its bag (being a receptacle of solid web). Ib. XXVIII, 9 <he>העושה … החרם … ומזוטו טמא</he> (ed. Dehr., Ar. ed. Koh. <he>ומן הזוטו</he>) a garment made out of a net is clean, but one made out of its solid portion &c.

senses.gloss: (cmp. שלל, שלולית) what the Sea throws out, deposits after the tide; the deposit or ore of a mine.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 21b:3">B. Mets. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>בזוּטוֹ של ים ובשלוליתו וכ׳</he> things found among the deposits of the Sea or the alluvium of a river.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:8:3">Cant. R. to IV, 8</cite> <he>מה החרמון הזה כל טוב נתון בזוטו</he> (not <he>טובו</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 988:40">Yalk. Cant. 988</cite> <he>בתוכו</he>) as in the Hermon all good things are deposited in its mines &c.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1:20">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵇ</cite> bot. (ref. to <he>צולה</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 44:27">Is. XLIV, 27</cite>) <he>זו בכל שהיא זוטו של עולם</he> that means Babylon which is the deposit of the world (the treasury of booty and commerce); Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh. 2) <cite ref="G00157"><he>זוטא</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
